svg.title: Strategy One - intent routing and concurrent execution
svg.desc: Chat is classified before a response or action request. A mailbox feeds events to the agent. The agent edits a FIFO queue; the executor runs one action at a time and posts completion results back to the mailbox. Model generation and physical execution can overlap.
